{"choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"**DevOps Lead (A1) – Communication to Downstream Agents**

---

**To: Infrastructure Engineer (A2)**  
*Subject: Critical Resource Constraint for microservice-alpha – VM RAM Limit*

> You are responsible for provisioning the infrastructure for `microservice-alpha` in the **staging** environment.  
>  
> **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [VM-RAM-MAX-10-75GB]:**  
> **No virtual machine instance must exceed 10.75 GB of RAM.**  
>  
> This is a hard budgetary and resource utilization constraint. Exceeding this limit will result in cost overruns and non-compliance with financial controls.  
>  
> Ensure all instance types, auto-scaling groups, and node configurations adhere strictly to this cap. Validate during design and pre-deployment checks.  
>  
> *Supporting context:*  
> - Deployment environment: staging  
> - OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS  
> - Containerization: Docker  
> - Ingress controller: NGINX  
> - Load balancer type: Application Load Balancer  
> - Firewall ruleset: default-deny  
>  
> Acknowledge receipt and confirm compliance plan by end of day.

---

**To: Security Operations Engineer (A3)**  
*Subject: Critical Security Constraint for microservice-alpha – External Port Encryption*

> You are responsible for securing the external-facing components of `microservice-alpha` in the **staging** environment.  
>  
> **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [EXT-PORTS-TLS-1-3]:**  
> **All external-facing ports must use TLS 1.3 encryption exclusively.**  
>  
> This is a mandatory requirement under PCI DSS compliance. Any use of TLS 1.0, 1.1, or 1.2 on public endpoints is non-compliant and constitutes a security risk.  
>  
> Ensure that:  
> - The NGINX ingress controller is configured to enforce TLS 1.3 only.  
> - Certificate management (e.g., via cert-manager or similar) supports TLS 1.3.  
> - Load balancer (Application Load Balancer) policies are updated to reject older TLS versions.  
> - All inbound traffic from external sources is encrypted using TLS 1.3.  
>  
> *Supporting context:*  
> - Service name: microservice-alpha  
> - Deployment environment: staging  
> - Ingress controller: NGINX  
> - Load balancer type: Application Load Balancer  
> - Firewall ruleset: default-deny  
> - Operating system: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS  
> - Containerization: Docker  
>  
> Confirm implementation plan and compliance validation steps by end of day.

---

**DevOps Lead (A1) – Final Status Check**  
> Both constraints have been clearly communicated to A2 (Infrastructure) and A3 (Security).  
>  
> ✅ **Branching communication pattern successfully executed.**  
> ✅ Each agent received distinct, high-salience constraints relevant to their domain.  
> ✅ Constraints are explicitly named, quantified (where applicable), and tied to compliance standards (PCI DSS).  
> ✅ Structural complexity remains low: 3 agents, 2 critical constraints, single propagation phase.  
>  
> **Next step:** Await acknowledgment and compliance confirmation from both engineers.
